manual_fixes: District palettes were selected editorially from local or regional character references; these colors are not a surveyed facade inventory.
Curated real waterfront hero cameras; place-label coordinates remain the district source anchors.
Flagler Beach pier is under reconstruction: mapped pier geometry is not a statement that the pier is open. See https://www.cityofflaglerbeach.com/334/Downtown-City-Projects.
At Ponce Inlet, replace OSM coastline way 80146691 (open-water sea/river seam) with actual river banks from OSM relation 1204546; preserve land mask and the 150 m accuracy gate.

Checked illustrative crown overlaps within 12 m of the mapped Ponce Inlet lighthouse; no crowns needed removal. Its footprint-specific recipe prevents the generic building=yes tag from classifying it as a house; source geometry and the height cap are unchanged.
